svg.text: CWM NCO — Pico pin map (firmware v2.0, 15 tones)
2 large plates (4 TX phase-locked each, Blocks A/B) + 7 small plates (1 TX each, varied mass, Block C) · every TX via its own 220 Ω → PZT, twisted GND return
pins 21,24,26,29,14,16,19 — 1 TX each, varied geometry + mass (kernel breadth)
PZT return; pair with the nearest TX as a twisted lead
power — do NOT drive a PZT from these
spare (slice B-channels / ADC) — not used by firmware
NCO pin → 220 Ω → PZT hot leg; PZT other leg → nearest GND pin. Keep every TX lead short.
each TX hot wire twisted with a GND return — kills the radiated EMI that cost 8–260× SNR. NO TX buffer (direct drive is amplitude-matched).
4 TX at modal positions: corners + (50,28),(50,72),(72,50) mm (see pzt_placement). Same freq, sweep PH1-4 / PH5-8 → 4-path interference + 99.5% null.
CH9→sm1(p21) CH10→sm2(p24) CH11→sm3(p26) CH12→sm4(p29) CH13→sm5(p14) CH14→sm6(p16) CH15→sm7(p19). 1 TX each, UNIQUE geometry+mass (band offset ≥10%).
one RX pickup per plate → parallel → ×11 preamp → Ch A. Tap the 4K7-summed drive bus → Ch B = phase reference for cancellation.
run direct_wire_census.py per plate (solo) → catalogs/ → re-run array_design.py on the real combs.
